S0.greeting.en: Hello. This is a safe place to report what happened to you, or to someone you know, at a government hospital. You do not need to give your name. Tell me what happened, in your own words. You can write in English or Pidgin.
S0.greeting.pcm: Hello. For here, you fit report wetin happen to you or your person for government hospital. You no need give your name. Just tell me wetin happen, as e take happen. You fit write am for English or Pidgin.

S0.privacy.en: Your words are read by an AI service to understand your report. We do not keep your original message, only a short summary with names removed.
S0.privacy.pcm: Na AI dey read wetin you write make e understand your report. We no dey keep your original message, na only short summary wey no get name.

S2.danger_check.en: {ack} One quick question first. Is anyone in danger right now? For example, someone who needs urgent treatment and is not getting it, or someone being held at the hospital. Reply YES or NO.
S2.danger_check.pcm: {ack} One quick question first. Anybody dey for danger as we dey talk so? Like person wey need treatment sharp sharp but dem never treat am, or person wey dem hold for hospital. Reply YES or NO.

S2.danger_retry.en: Sorry, I did not get that. Is anyone in danger right now? Please reply YES or NO.
S2.danger_retry.pcm: Abeg, I no too understand. Anybody dey for danger now now? Reply YES or NO.

A1.emergency_refused.en:
Get care first. If the person is getting worse, call {contact:emergency}, or go to the nearest other hospital. Do not wait for an answer from this one, and do not stay to argue.

Then, if you can:
1. Ask calmly for the most senior doctor or officer on duty. You can say: "Section 20 of the National Health Act says a hospital or health worker must not refuse a person emergency medical treatment for any reason."
2. The law is about not being refused. It does not say the treatment is free; the bill can be sorted out after the person is safe. If money is the problem, ask for the hospital's Social Welfare Unit.
3. When you can, note the time, the department (for example Casualty), and who you spoke to.

I cannot send anyone to you. I will record this so it is counted.
A1.emergency_refused.pcm:
Make the person get treatment first. If e condition dey worse, call {contact:emergency}, or carry am go another hospital wey near. No wait for this one, no stay dey argue.

After that, if you fit:
1. Ask gently for the most senior doctor or officer wey dey duty. You fit talk say: "Section 20 of National Health Act talk say hospital or health worker no suppose refuse to treat person wey get emergency, for any reason."
2. Wetin the law talk na say dem no fit refuse. E no talk say the treatment free; una fit settle the bill after the person don safe. If na money be the problem, ask for the hospital Social Welfare Unit.
3. When you fit, write the time, the department (like Casualty), and who you follow talk.

I no fit send anybody come meet you. But I go record am make e count.

A1.detention.en:
Many people have faced this, and you have options. A hospital bill is a debt, and there are proper ways to settle a debt. The Patients' Bill of Rights says hospitals should use legal means to recover their fees.

What you can do:
1. Ask to speak to the hospital's Social Welfare Unit (some hospitals call it Medical Social Services) about a payment plan or a waiver.
2. Ask for a written, itemised bill.
3. Ask the Medical Director's office to tell you in writing what is needed for discharge.
4. {contact:legal_aid}

If the person being held is unwell, or is a newborn or a child, tell the staff clearly.

I cannot send anyone to you. I will record this so it is counted.
A1.detention.pcm:
Plenty people don face this kind thing, and you get options. Hospital bill na debt, and correct way dey to settle debt. Patients' Bill of Rights talk say hospital suppose use legal way collect dem money.

Wetin you fit do:
1. Ask make you see the hospital Social Welfare Unit (some hospital dey call am Medical Social Services), make una talk about how you go pay small small or whether dem fit waive am.
2. Ask make dem give you the bill for paper, with everything wey dem charge written.
3. Ask the Medical Director office make dem write wetin remain before dem go discharge the person.
4. {contact:legal_aid}

If the person wey dem hold no well, or na newborn or pikin, tell the staff clear clear.

I no fit send anybody come meet you. But I go record am make e count.

A1.detention.note: States no legal conclusion: there is no Nigerian statute or appellate case on hospital detention. 'Social Welfare Unit' is the term Lagos officials use. Pidgin is a draft.

A1.generic.en:
Getting care comes first. If someone is in danger right now, call {contact:emergency}. If you cannot get through, go to the nearest other hospital, or ask someone near you to help.

If you can, ask for the most senior doctor or nurse on duty and tell them plainly that the patient needs help now. Note the time, the department, and who you spoke to.

I cannot send anyone to you. I will record this so it is counted.
A1.generic.pcm:
Make the person get treatment first. If anybody dey for danger now now, call {contact:emergency}. If the call no go, carry the person go another hospital wey near, or ask person wey dey near you make e help.

If you fit, ask for the most senior doctor or nurse wey dey duty, tell am straight say the patient need help now now. Write the time, the department, and who you follow talk.

I no fit send anybody come meet you. But I go record am make e count.

Q.department.en: Which part of the hospital? For example emergency, maternity, children's ward.
Q.department.pcm: Which side for the hospital? Like emergency, maternity, children ward.

Q.when.en: When did this happen? Today, this week, or earlier?
Q.when.pcm: When e happen? Today, this week, or e don tey?

Q.category_confirm.en: Just to be sure I understand: is this mainly about {category_plain}? Reply YES or NO.
Q.category_confirm.pcm: Make I sure say I understand: na {category_plain} be the main matter? Reply YES or NO.

B2.template.en: What happened to you is not acceptable, and it is not just your opinion. {right_text} ({source})
B2.template.pcm: Wetin dem do you no correct, and no be only you talk am. {right_text} ({source})

B3.abuse.en:
What you can do:
1. If you feel safe doing so, ask for the nurse in charge or matron of the ward and tell them what happened.
2. Note the time, the ward, and what was said or done. If someone saw it, remember who.
3. You do not have to confront anyone. Reporting here already counts.

B3.neglect.en:
What you can do:
1. Ask at the nurses' station who the nurse in charge is and which doctor is on call.
2. If the patient is getting worse, tell me now and I will show you what to do.
3. Note the time you asked for help and how long you waited.

B3.other.en:
What you can do:
1. Note the date, the department, and what happened while it is fresh.
2. Keep any receipts, bills or papers you were given.
3. Reporting here already counts.

B4.receipt.en: Your report is recorded. Your code is {ref_code}. Keep it. It is the only way to check or update your report. I did not store your name or number.
B4.receipt.pcm: We don record your report. Your code na {ref_code}. Keep am well. Na only that code you fit use check or update your report. I no keep your name or number.

B4.counted.en: Your report has been counted. When enough reports about the same problem build up at a hospital, the pattern (numbers only, never stories) goes to {org_name}, who use it to push publicly for change at that hospital.
B4.counted.pcm: We don count your report. When plenty report about the same wahala gather for one hospital, the pattern (na only numbers, no be story) go reach {org_name}, wey go use am push for change for that hospital for public.

B4.no_hospital.en: I have recorded this, but without the hospital's name it cannot be counted with other reports. You can come back with your code and add it.

B5.optin.en: May I check in tomorrow to ask if anything changed? It helps show whether hospitals fix problems. Reply YES or NO.
B5.optin.pcm: I fit check on you tomorrow to ask whether anything change? E go help show whether hospital dey fix matter. Reply YES or NO.

B5.yes.en: Thank you. Come back here tomorrow with your code and I will ask how things are. Take care of yourself.
B5.yes.pcm: Thank you. Come back here tomorrow with your code, I go ask how e dey go. Take care of yourself.

B5.no.en: No problem. Thank you for speaking up. Take care of yourself.
B5.no.pcm: No wahala. Thank you say you talk. Take care of yourself.

F1.question.en:
Hello again. You reported {category_plain} at {hospital}. How are things now?
1. It was sorted out
2. Nothing has changed
3. It got worse
4. We have left the hospital
Reply with a number.
F1.question.pcm:
Hello again. You report {category_plain} for {hospital}. How e dey now?
1. Dem don sort am
2. Nothing change
3. E don worse
4. We don comot for the hospital
Reply with number.

F2.resolved.en: I am glad to hear that. Thank you for telling me. It has been recorded.
F2.resolved.pcm: I happy to hear that one. Thank you. We don record am.

F2.unchanged.en: I am sorry nothing has changed. That has been recorded, and it matters: it shows the problem was not fixed.
F2.unchanged.pcm: Sorry say nothing change. We don record am, and e matter: e show say dem no fix the problem.

F2.left.en: Thank you for telling me. It has been recorded. I hope things get better from here.
F2.left.pcm: Thank you. We don record am. I hope say things go better from here.

F2.worse.en: I am sorry to hear that. It has been recorded.
F2.worse.pcm: Sorry to hear that one. We don record am.

E.clinical.en: I cannot judge medical decisions, like whether a diagnosis or treatment was right. I can still record what happened. Complaints about a doctor's or dentist's professional conduct are handled by the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria; its form asks for a sworn affidavit. The Patients' Bill of Rights says to complain to the hospital first, then the regulator, then the FCCPC.

E.retry.pcm: I no too understand. Abeg tell me wetin happen for the hospital, as e take happen.

E.end.en: I am not able to help with that here. If something happened to you at a government hospital, you can come back any time and tell me.
E.end.pcm: I no fit help with that one for here. If something happen to you for government hospital, you fit come back any time tell me.

E.expired.en: That conversation has ended. You can start a new report whenever you are ready.
E.expired.pcm: That conversation don end. You fit start new report anytime.

E.unverified_fallback.en: I have recorded what you told me. The guidance for this situation is still being checked, so I cannot show it yet. If anyone is in danger, please get to the nearest other hospital or emergency service now.
E.unverified_fallback.pcm: I don record wetin you tell me. We still dey check the advice for this kind matter, so I no fit show am yet. If anybody dey for danger, abeg carry am go another hospital wey near now now.

L.not_found.en: I could not find a report with that code. Please check it and try again.
L.not_found.pcm: I no see any report with that code. Abeg check am well, try again.

L.found.en: Your report about {category_plain} at {hospital} is on record. Status: {status}.
L.found.pcm: Your report about {category_plain} for {hospital} dey our record. Status: {status}.

S1.ack.en: I am sorry this happened. Thank you for telling me.
S1.ack.pcm: Sorry say this happen. Thank you say you tell me.

B3.staff.en:
Thank you. It takes courage to speak up from the inside.

To keep yourself safe:
1. You do not have to confront anyone or report this inside the hospital. Reporting here already counts.
2. If you keep notes, keep dates, shifts and what staff were told to do. Do not copy patient records or take photos of patients.
3. Do not use a work phone, work computer or hospital Wi-Fi to contact us.

E.unavailable.en: Something went wrong on our side and I could not record that. Please try again in a moment. If anyone is in danger, do not wait for me: get to the nearest other hospital or emergency service now.
E.unavailable.pcm: Something spoil for our side, I no fit record am. Abeg try again small time. If anybody dey for danger, no wait for me: carry am go another hospital wey near now now.

A1.detention_body.en:
We are sorry for your loss.

What you can do:
1. Ask the hospital's Social Welfare Unit and the Medical Director's office what is needed to release your relative, and ask them to put it in writing.
2. Ask for a written, itemised bill, including mortuary charges.
3. {contact:legal_aid}

I cannot send anyone to you. I will record this so it is counted.
